title: Sparkly star
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7a8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f1c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7df9ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main star body -->
  <polygon points='50,10 61,38 90,38 67,56 76,85 50,67 24,85 33,56 10,38 39,38'
           fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#ffb703' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- Inner highlight for the star -->
  <polygon points='50,22 57,42 78,42 61,53 67,72 50,60 33,72 39,53 22,42 43,42'
           fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- Sparkle 1: top left -->
  <g transform='translate(18,18)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-8' x2='0' y2='8' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-8' y1='0' x2='8' y2='0' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='-5' x2='5' y2='5' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='5' y1='-5' x2='-5' y2='5' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 2: top right -->
  <g transform='translate(82,14)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 3: bottom left -->
  <g transform='translate(14,78)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 4: bottom right -->
  <g transform='translate(85,80)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-7' x2='0' y2='7' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-7' y1='0' x2='7' y2='0' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='url(#sparkle)' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='25' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='92' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='94' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='5' r='1.5' fill='#7df9ff'/>

  <!-- Cute face on the star -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#5b3a00'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#5b3a00'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='44.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='44.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 57 56 52' fill='none' stroke='#5b3a00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fab' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
